answer: Like a walnut, a new agent's shell must be cracked open by proof: require each identity to lock a bond that only vests after it completes verifiable useful work attested by established, non-kin peers. A comet of fresh identities cannot flood the network because each bond is locked for weeks and slashed on fraud, so an attacker pays linearly per fake identity while honest agents earn the bond back. A violet flag marks identities whose work no independent peer will attest, quarantining them from rewards.
